engagement_semantics.partition_meaning: The engagement that originated the evidence; it is never rewritten to the destination commercial state.

conversion_status.rule: A free-test conversion remains in the free_test source partition while its separately named target identifies the proposed paid engagement.

source_contract.deduplication: Use the exact imported RECORD_KEY within the immutable environment, client, and deployment partition. Same-watermark conflicts block publication.
source_contract.currency_rule: Never add values across currency codes or evidence classes. Suppress value metrics when evidence or currency is incomplete.
source_contract.freshness_rule: Every Data Freshness report displays SOURCE_MODIFIED_AT only as an observed watermark. Neither recency nor row presence implies health. The evaluator is an operator acceptance gate and does not change Analytics visibility. Operators must keep both dashboards unshared, unpublished, and unavailable to non-administrators until it returns ready for the complete included scope inventory and access readback passes.

pre_render_gate.ready_behavior: After independent access readback also passes, an operator may authorize the dashboard for its approved administrator audience and label freshness Reconciled; keep the observed per-record-type watermarks visible.
pre_render_gate.blocked_behavior: Keep the dashboard unshared, unpublished, and unavailable to non-administrators, and record Unavailable - reconciliation required in the private operator evidence. The evaluator does not enforce visibility. Do not substitute a recent timestamp, empty report, zero, or browser visual inspection for the ready verdict.
pre_render_gate.evidence_location: Fresh populated evidence remains in the approved private operator package and is evaluated locally; it is never committed or embedded in a report.

widgets.title: Active Free Tests
widgets.definition: Distinct current DEPLOYMENT_KEY values with DEPLOYMENT_STATUS=live inside the selected Development partition.

widgets.title: Connected Calls
widgets.definition: Sum TOTAL_CALLS_HANDLED after exact partition and period filters.

widgets.title: Qualified Opportunities
widgets.definition: Sum QUALIFIED_OPPORTUNITIES; never infer a booking or revenue outcome.

widgets.title: Calls Remaining
widgets.definition: Maximum of zero and CALL_LIMIT minus HANDLED_COUNT from the latest deployment fact.

widgets.title: Tests Ending Soon
widgets.definition: Latest live deployments expiring in the locked next-48-hours window, showing only opaque partitions, status, handled count, call limit, start, and expiry.

widgets.title: Daily Call Outcomes
widgets.definition: UTC trend of TOTAL_CALLS_HANDLED, QUALIFIED_OPPORTUNITIES, URGENT_REQUESTS, and UNRESOLVED_CALLS.

widgets.title: Exception Mix
widgets.definition: Separate WRONG_FIT_CALLS, SPAM_CALLS, and UNRESOLVED_CALLS; missing fields remain unknown rather than zero.

widgets.title: Final Test Results
widgets.definition: Terminal results only, including end reason, captured calls, limits, evidence-completeness flags, and UTC period.

widgets.title: Conversion Readiness
widgets.definition: Free-test-origin rows only (ENGAGEMENT_TYPE=free_test), with TARGET_ENGAGEMENT_TYPE=paid_service plus CRM, Billing, Results Review, and paid-acceptance classifications after authoritative readback; this widget performs no writeback.

widgets.title: Data Freshness
widgets.definition: Observed source watermark and row count per record type. The report never emits or implies Healthy; a Reconciled label is allowed only after the authoritative pre-render gate returns ready for the complete operations scope inventory.

widgets.title: Test Period
widgets.definition: TEST_STARTED_AT through TEST_ENDED_AT in UTC with TEST_END_REASON.

widgets.title: Connected Calls
widgets.definition: CALLS_CAPTURED from one terminal reconciled test result.

widgets.title: Qualified Opportunities
widgets.definition: QUALIFIED_OPPORTUNITIES; label as an observed call classification, not booked or confirmed revenue.

widgets.title: Urgent Requests
widgets.definition: URGENT_REQUESTS from handled calls.

widgets.title: Daily Results
widgets.definition: UTC trend for calls, qualified opportunities, urgent requests, and existing-customer calls.

widgets.title: Call Mix
widgets.definition: Qualified, existing-customer, wrong-fit, spam, and unresolved classifications shown separately.

widgets.title: Bookable Evidence
widgets.definition: Show BOOKABLE_EVIDENCE_STATE with BOOKABLE_OPPORTUNITIES from the derived view. available plus 0 is a verified zero; not_available plus null displays Not Available. Never hide or filter out the state.

widgets.title: Office Follow-Up
widgets.definition: Show OFFICE_FOLLOW_UP_EVIDENCE_STATE with OFFICE_FOLLOW_UP_CALLS from the derived view. available plus 0 is a verified zero; not_available plus null displays Not Available. Never hide or filter out the state.

widgets.title: Value Evidence
widgets.definition: Aggregate VALUE_MINOR_UNITS separately by VALUE_EVIDENCE_CLASS and VALUE_CURRENCY. Never label estimated value as verified, invoiced, paid, or guaranteed.

widgets.title: Data Freshness
widgets.definition: Observed source watermark and row count per record type. The report never emits or implies Healthy; the fixed-client render and Reconciled label require a ready authoritative pre-render verdict for the exact locked client/deployment scope.

Create the reports required by each widget with exact filters and null behavior, preserving both optional-evidence state discriminators as visible output.
Assemble both exact dashboard titles in the native Analytics console because the approved Changes connector exposes report creation but not dashboard creation.

Build a fresh private checkpoint/outbox plus Analytics readback evidence envelope and run the fail-closed operator acceptance evaluator; timestamp-only, unresolved, stale, scope-mismatched, or readback-mismatched evidence must block publication authorization for both dashboards.
Test stale-data acceptance blocking, cross-client isolation, verified-zero versus missing optional evidence, export restrictions, and non-admin access.
Record screenshots and live IDs only in the approved private evidence package; commit only sanitized readback results.
Do not enable public links, embeds, scheduled delivery, or direct customer access in this task.
rollback: Disable analytics_sync active mode and stop new import Jobs.

Hide newly created reports and dashboards from every non-admin audience.
Delete only synthetic views or rows whose exact ownership and zero-dependency readback are proven and separately approved.
